name: readability
description: Readability scores of a text. English: Flesch reading ease with its band, Flesch-Kincaid grade, Gunning fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau and ARI. Spanish: Fernández-Huerta and Szigriszt-Pazos with the INFLESZ band, from exact Spanish syllabification. Also the counts behind them: sentences, words, syllables, letters, polysyllables.

input.text: El gato come pan. La niña lee un libro en el país.

catalog.source: Flesch (1948), Kincaid et al. (1975), Gunning (1952), McLaughlin (1969), Coleman & Liau (1975), Fernández Huerta (1959), Szigriszt Pazos (1993) and Barrio-Cantalejo et al. (2008, INFLESZ); formulas as in textstat (github.com/textstat/textstat)
